basis: Same 200 frozen cases, answer key and scoring method as results/scores.json. A case without a usable forecast is scored at the final Street consensus, contributing zero improvement.

rows.note: 198 usable forecasts. Two cases were flagged for target-results exposure on all three attempts and are scored at Street consensus.

limitations: Added after the nine-configuration release. The release evidence audit in results/snapshot-evidence-audit.json has not been repeated for these two runs.
Run with a later Shortcut runtime setup than the released Shortcut rows, so differences reflect the setup as well as the model.
Knowledge cutoffs for these two models are later than the released models' (reported as June 2026) and have not been checked against provider documentation.
Retrospective cutoffs and post-report consensus. exploratory, not a point-in-time leaderboard.
